column3: a component exports the program's functions under the canonical ABI (s32/f64 lifted, a string as pointer+length, cabi_realloc on the text heap): the warp emitter exports no program function by its own signature (export is only a modifier, core/parsing), so the adapters are core/emitter work; only the WIT text (--wit) would be an extension

funcref slots mean every call of a reloadable function goes call_indirect through a table the emitter writes and the host refills (core/emitter); and warp dev itself is not in the warp-written native warp yet (core/native/warp.warp has no dev command, the Rust dev_server.rs is gone)

the modules step is core: core/compiler.warp write_modules compiles every module in one process in in_dependency_order, run by core/native/warp.warp rebuilt() before warp.wasm is replaced; scripts/ cannot split it without a rebuild-until-runtime entry there (WARP_JOBS would fan out 'module <name>' per dependency level)
